titre: The format fits in a few words. Here is how a session actually runs.
intro: This training is delivered live, with an expert, not through a recording to watch on your own.
deroule: Join the live session at the time shown on your booked slot
The trainer presents the module, with live discussion
Demonstration by the trainer, with screen sharing
Practical case at the end of the module, completed with the trainer's support
Time for questions and a wrap-up before the session closes
fourni: A downloadable PDF handout for each module
Access to the learner area to track your progress
The corrected practical case for each module
prerequis: No SAP prerequisites are needed to follow this training.
dureeAcces: Access to the materials lasts 6 months from the date of the training.

modalites.description: Each session is led live by a certified expert.
Video add-ons are being considered for a future version — not included at this time.

temoignages.citation: The practical cases at the end of each module let me redo my purchase requisitions in Ariba the very next day. Live makes all the difference: you ask the question the moment it comes up.
A training course that goes straight to the everyday tasks of the job. Supplier follow-up and order management became clear, with no needless jargon.
Five modules in the order of a real purchasing cycle, with a trainer who shares their screen. I came in with no prerequisites and I leave able to work on my own.

bandeau.texte: {duree} with the trainer to check that the programme meets your needs, with no commitment.
